n72350b6e45.headline: Ethiopia’s parliament approves extra $4.8 bln spending in 2024/25
n72350b6e45.summary: Ethiopian lawmakers approved an additional 581.98 billion birr ($4.8 billion) in spending for the 2024/25 fiscal year. The extra outlay adds to 971.2 billion birr already announced, a 21% increase.
n72350b6e45.why: Expanded government spending affects Ethiopia's fiscal deficit, borrowing needs and external financing, which matter to investors in its sovereign debt.

nafd2079512.headline: New Wage Deal Paves Way for Growth and Record Investments
nafd2079512.summary: Hungary has signed a three-year wage agreement with a historic increase, and the government targets economic growth of over 3% in 2025. Prime Minister Viktor Orbán spoke at the signing ceremony.
nafd2079512.why: Wage agreements shape labour costs, inflation and consumer spending. Growth targets guide public investment and fiscal planning.

n2a8d1ec92e.headline: No disparity between ours, NUPRC’s crude oil production figures – NNPC |
n2a8d1ec92e.summary: NNPC Limited said there is no disparity between its crude oil production figures and those of the NUPRC. Olufemi Soneye, its chief corporate communications officer, made the statement on Monday.
n2a8d1ec92e.why: Nigeria's oil output figures drive government revenue and the budget. Discrepancies between official sources matter for investors assessing Nigerian crude supply.

n19784573d3.headline: Trump has promised lower taxes. These are 3 ways it could impact you
n19784573d3.summary: Donald Trump has made a range of tax promises, including no tax on tips and changes to Social Security. NPR examines three changes Americans could see in the months ahead.
n19784573d3.why: US tax policy shapes household income, consumer spending and corporate earnings. Campaign tax proposals often preview future fiscal and regulatory direction.

n0097181726.headline: South African Markets – Factors to watch on Nov 26
n0097181726.summary: The rand strengthened on Monday as investors started the week on the front foot. Scheduled events include the leading business cycle indicator, a government bond auction and Pepkor's full-year results.
n0097181726.why: The rand and South African bond auctions shape local borrowing costs and the returns foreign investors earn on South African assets.

n5353d2d0d4.headline: Vulcan Energy in talks to license lithium filtration technology
n5353d2d0d4.summary: Vulcan Energy is negotiating with various lithium enterprises to license its filtration technology. The talks are at an early stage according to the description.
n5353d2d0d4.why: Lithium is a key input for electric vehicle batteries, and licensing deals can generate royalty revenue for technology developers.

n1e84114e24.headline: Brent Crude - Oil Eyes Recovery as OPEC + Deliberate Oil Cut Rollover
n1e84114e24.summary: Oil prices rose in early European trade after a Monday drop. OPEC+ is set to meet on December 1 to discuss a potential rollover of its oil cuts into 2025.
n1e84114e24.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil-producing nations whose output decisions strongly influence global crude supply and prices. Brent is the main international benchmark for crude oil.

n14e1d936c9.headline: American Woodmark:  Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
n14e1d936c9.summary: FD Technologies said half-year trading was in line with expectations as it progresses with its divestment of First Derivatives. It plans to return GBP120 million to shareholders.
n14e1d936c9.why: FD Technologies is a Northern Ireland-based software company, and capital returns after divestments are closely watched by investors.

ndf1f4b1f46.headline: African Markets – Factors to watch on Nov 26
ndf1f4b1f46.summary: The dollar rallied sharply on Tuesday after U.S. President-elect Donald Trump pledged tariffs on all imports. The move came as markets reacted to the trade policy pledge.
ndf1f4b1f46.why: Tariffs on broad imports can raise inflation and reshape trade flows, which affects currencies and global risk appetite. The dollar often strengthens when US policy expectations shift sharply.
ndf1f4b1f46.why_moved: After President-elect Trump pledged tariffs on all imports, the dollar rallied sharply, a reaction to expected trade and inflation effects.

nc7e6acaceb.headline: Italy tax police search legal firms in Agnelli inheritance probe
nc7e6acaceb.summary: Italian tax police searched offices of several legal firms in an investigation into alleged tax fraud involving five people, including Stellantis and Ferrari chair John Elkann.
nc7e6acaceb.why: Stellantis and Ferrari are major listed carmakers, and governance or legal issues involving their leadership can affect investor confidence.

nd72853234e.headline: Mexico president says migrant caravans will not reach US after Trump tariff threat
nd72853234e.summary: Mexico's president said migrant caravans will not reach the United States, following a tariff threat from President Trump. She also underlined Mexico's aspirations to regulate drug circulation.
nd72853234e.why: US tariff threats against Mexico affect trade flows, the peso and Mexican export-oriented manufacturers that rely on US demand.

ndeae53a499.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street rises to records despite tariff talk
ndeae53a499.summary: US stocks closed at more records after Donald Trump's latest tariff remarks created only some ripples. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to another all-time high.
ndeae53a499.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index for large US equities, and tariff policy affects corporate earnings expectations and trade-exposed sectors.

nb6e34f4c5e.headline: Dangote Refinery, 8 other completed fuel processing facilities in Nigeria
nb6e34f4c5e.summary: Port Harcourt Refinery has officially commenced operations and is running at 60% capacity. A list of completed refineries in Nigeria includes the Dangote Refinery.
nb6e34f4c5e.why: Domestic refining capacity affects Nigeria's fuel imports, foreign exchange demand and the country's exposure to crude export markets.

n93886759dd.summary: Exxon Mobil said US oil and gas producers will not raise output significantly in coming years, despite calls from President-elect Donald Trump to drill. The comments were reported by Bloomberg.

n8515832833.summary: Kenyans have raised concerns about double taxation in the Tax Laws Bill, which originated from the National Treasury. The bill proposes a range of tax measures on several sectors of the economy.
n8515832833.why: Tax policy changes affect corporate profitability, consumer spending and investor confidence in Kenya's economy.

n60d001519a.headline: Iraq, Saudi, Russia stress need for stable oil market ahead of OPEC+ meeting
n60d001519a.summary: OPEC+ members Iraq, Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed at a meeting in Iraq on the importance of stable oil markets and fair prices, Iraq's Prime Minister Office said.
n60d001519a.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil producers whose output decisions strongly influence global crude supply and prices.

n47c08b25e2.headline: Empire Energy executes binding commitment letters for milestone A$65 million Beetaloo financing package
n47c08b25e2.summary: Empire Energy Group has executed binding commitment letters for a milestone A$65 million financing package with Macquarie Bank for development of its Beetaloo project.
n47c08b25e2.why: Project financing determines whether early-stage energy developers can fund exploration and development, which matters for small-cap energy investors.

ne18d0523de.headline: RWS appoints European tech heavyweight Benjamin Faes as CEO
ne18d0523de.summary: RWS Holdings confirmed Benjamin Faes, a former Google director and tech industry veteran, as its next chief executive officer. RWS is a software company based in Buckinghamshire, England.
ne18d0523de.why: RWS is a UK-listed language and content technology company, and leadership changes can affect strategy and investor confidence.

nc465815709.headline: Irish Continental says 'Oscar Wilde' helps revenue growth
nc465815709.summary: Irish Continental Group reported revenue of EUR521.0 million for the first ten months of 2024, up 5.8% from EUR491.4 million a year earlier. The company credited its Oscar Wilde ferry.
nc465815709.why: Irish Continental is a Dublin-based ferry operator on Irish Sea and Channel routes, so its volumes reflect trade and tourism flows.

n9b112e165b.headline: With 3.46% GDP growth in Q3, Nigeria’s economy on course – Presidency
n9b112e165b.summary: President Bola Tinubu said Nigeria's economy continues to expand after the newly released third-quarter data showed GDP growth of 3.46%.
n9b112e165b.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic output, and it shapes investor views on Nigeria's growth, currency and fiscal outlook.

nfdb7325b41.headline: Halfords may raise garage prices for drivers to cover £23m cost hit from Budget
nfdb7325b41.summary: Halfords said the cost implications of next April's rise in national insurance contributions and the minimum wage increase were particularly acute, and it may raise garage prices.
nfdb7325b41.why: Halfords is a UK retailer of car parts, bikes and garage services, so higher employer costs directly affect its margins and pricing.

nbf907642f0.headline: S&P and Nasdaq gain despite Dow’s drop; Amgen, Kohl’s shares fall - Invezz
nbf907642f0.summary: US stocks were mixed, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gaining while the Dow fell. Amgen and Kohl's shares dropped in the session.
nbf907642f0.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are the main benchmarks for US large-cap and technology-heavy equities, while the Dow tracks 30 large industrial and consumer companies.

n325b9a8df3.headline: We borrow based on your approvals, FG tells NASS
n325b9a8df3.summary: The federal government told the National Assembly that it continues to borrow even though it has exceeded revenue targets. The issue came up during interactive sessions on revenue generation.
n325b9a8df3.why: Government borrowing levels affect sovereign debt costs, fiscal sustainability and the naira's stability for investors in Nigeria.

n09ede5fe0d.headline: Israeli security cabinet approves Lebanon ceasefire deal, after 11th-hour strikes on central Beirut
n09ede5fe0d.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said his security cabinet approved a ceasefire deal with Hezbollah, clearing the way for the truce to take effect. The move follows strikes on central Beirut.
n09ede5fe0d.why: Hezbollah is a Lebanese armed group, and Middle East ceasefires influence regional risk premiums, energy market sentiment and investor confidence across the region.
n09ede5fe0d.why_moved: The cabinet approval clears the way for a truce with Hezbollah, which reduces the near-term risk of wider conflict in the region.

n46ae656b1b.headline: NIMC officials explain benefits of upcoming multipurpose national ID card | Biometric Update
n46ae656b1b.summary: Officials described the upcoming multipurpose national ID card, which will be used for various financial transactions. The move seeks to improve financial inclusion and G2P payments.
n46ae656b1b.why: Digital identity systems can widen access to banking and government payments, which affects financial inclusion and the reach of fintech and payment providers.

n257e7e5ccb.headline: Mexico suggests it would impose its own tariffs to retaliate against any Trump tariffs
n257e7e5ccb.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum suggested Mexico could retaliate with tariffs after Donald Trump threatened 25% import duties on Mexican goods. The threat is tied to drug and migrant flows.
n257e7e5ccb.why: Mexico is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff threats affect cross-border supply chains, autos, and the peso.
n257e7e5ccb.why_moved: Trump's threat of 25% duties on Mexican goods, and Sheinbaum's suggestion of retaliatory tariffs, raise the risk of a trade conflict between the two countries.

nd8e1c2674a.headline: Massive EU-South American free trade pact would reduce tariffs, but some farmers are opposed
nd8e1c2674a.summary: The EU and the South American bloc Mercosur are working to finalise a trade deal that has been under negotiation for years. The agreement would reduce tariffs, but some farmers are opposed.
nd8e1c2674a.why: The EU-Mercosur agreement would cut tariffs between a major European bloc and South America, affecting agricultural and industrial trade flows.

neb5d964299.headline: Tariff pe tariff to narrow the deficit
neb5d964299.summary: Donald Trump's proposed tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China signal a return to his negotiating tactics. The proposals are creating market volatility amid debt and deficit concerns.
neb5d964299.why: US tariffs on major trading partners affect trade flows, supply chains and currencies across North America and Asia.
neb5d964299.why_moved: Proposed tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China are creating market volatility, according to the input.

n9f59e47b37.headline: Cheche :  Reports Third Quarter 2024 Unaudited Financial Results Form 6 K
n9f59e47b37.summary: Beijing-based Cheche Group, described as China's leading auto insurance technology platform, has released unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2024.
n9f59e47b37.why: Cheche is a listed Chinese auto insurance technology platform, so its quarterly results indicate the health of China's online car insurance market.

nd75665e10d.headline: Northvolt is out of money but is there hope for its technology?
nd75665e10d.summary: Northvolt has gone bankrupt and is out of money, while European carmakers still need its automotive batteries for future production targets.
nd75665e10d.why: Northvolt was a European battery cell maker supplying carmakers, so its collapse affects Europe's electric vehicle supply chain.

n4f0ea0d3eb.headline: Nymex Overview :  Oil Up on Report OPEC+ to Delay Production Increase -- OPIS
n4f0ea0d3eb.summary: Crude futures rebounded from the previous day's sharp declines after a report that OPEC and its allies are discussing postponing a scheduled January production increase.
n4f0ea0d3eb.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil producers whose output decisions strongly influence global crude supply and prices.
n4f0ea0d3eb.why_moved: Reports that OPEC and its allies may postpone a scheduled production increase suggest tighter supply, which pushed crude futures higher after earlier declines.

na9cb4601fb.headline: Labor’s Housing Bill Clears Senate After a Near-300 Day Stalemate
na9cb4601fb.summary: Labor's housing bill has cleared the Senate after a stalemate of nearly 300 days, establishing Australia's first national shared equity scheme, Help to Buy.
na9cb4601fb.why: Housing policy affects construction activity, mortgage demand and the wider Australian economy that investors track.

n1b80bdb8e7.headline: Vedanta eyes $2 billion copper project investments in Saudi Arabia | Company Business News
n1b80bdb8e7.summary: Vedanta Ltd is looking to invest $2 billion in copper projects in Saudi Arabia through its wholly owned subsidiary Vedanta Copper International. The report cites PTI.
n1b80bdb8e7.why: Vedanta is an Indian diversified mining group, and copper is a key input for electrical and energy infrastructure. Overseas projects diversify its resource base.

nfff961381c.headline: Asian FX, Chinese Stocks To Be Hit By Trump Tariffs: Analysts
nfff961381c.summary: Markets are likely to remain under pressure as traders reassess positions after President-elect Donald Trump announced trade levies on Mexico and Canada and higher tariffs on China.
nfff961381c.why: Tariffs raise costs for exporters and can weigh on trade-exposed economies, currencies and equities. The US is a major export market for many Asian economies.
nfff961381c.why_moved: Traders are reassessing positions after the announced tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China, which threaten trade flows for Asian economies and Chinese exporters.

n4af4a03ea2.headline: Immigration detention center contractor sues over California health inspections
n4af4a03ea2.summary: GEO Group, a large private prison contractor, filed a federal lawsuit last month against California officials. The suit seeks to strike down a state law allowing local health officials to inspect detention facilities.
n4af4a03ea2.why: GEO Group is a US private prison and detention operator, so state rules on facility inspections affect its operations and revenue.

n96cfbf8f0a.headline: Kmart NZ reveals bumper profit
n96cfbf8f0a.summary: Kmart grew its net profit by over 50% year-on-year in New Zealand despite a tough retail environment. The figures were reported by NZ Herald.
n96cfbf8f0a.why: Kmart NZ is a discount retailer owned by Australian conglomerate Wesfarmers, so its results feed into the group's retail performance.

n7817b6a2b9.headline: Biden Proposal to Cover Obesity Drugs Sets Up Quandary for Trump
n7817b6a2b9.summary: The Biden administration is proposing a rule that would require the US government to cover obesity drugs for millions of Americans, setting up a financial and political challenge for the incoming Trump administration.
n7817b6a2b9.why: Obesity drugs are a major growth area for drugmakers, and government coverage rules affect their revenue and the cost of public health programs.

ne726aa8fae.headline: Beware the butterfly as BNPL moves into a new phase of financing
ne726aa8fae.summary: New UK buy-now-pay-later legislation focuses on consumer protection, though the article warns of systemic risks as the sector moves into a new financing phase.
ne726aa8fae.why: Buy-now-pay-later lenders provide short-term consumer credit at checkout, and regulation shapes their lending practices and profitability.

n9ea5f78d46.headline: Ishiba urges Biden to approve Nippon-U.S. Steel deal, sources say
n9ea5f78d46.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba sent a letter asking U.S. President Joe Biden to approve the Nippon Steel deal, sources say, to avoid harming recent efforts to strengthen ties.
n9ea5f78d46.why: Nippon Steel is a major Japanese steelmaker, and its proposed acquisition of U.S. Steel is a large cross-border deal that needs US government clearance.

n3f9ff6a7d4.summary: The Indian government approved the PAN 2.0 project, which will create a central PAN card database by merging data from current providers and is expected to lower costs for fintech firms.
n3f9ff6a7d4.why: PAN is India's tax identification system used in banking and financial transactions, so changes to it affect fintech operations and compliance costs.

n76cd43c8c7.headline: Trump pledges tariffs against Mexico, Canada and China
n76cd43c8c7.summary: President-elect Donald Trump announced tariffs on goods from Mexico, Canada and China, which many economists warn could raise prices for American consumers.
n76cd43c8c7.why: Tariffs on major trading partners raise import costs, affect supply chains and can trigger retaliation and currency moves.
n76cd43c8c7.why_moved: Economists warn the tariffs could raise prices for American consumers, and the announced levies on three major trading partners raise trade-disruption risk.

n7ac950a308.headline: Biden administration proposes expanding obesity drug coverage under Medicare and Medicaid
n7ac950a308.summary: The Biden administration has proposed a rule to significantly expand coverage of anti-obesity medications for Americans on Medicare and Medicaid, according to the White House.
n7ac950a308.why: Medicare and Medicaid are large US government health programs, so coverage rules shape demand and pricing for drug makers and insurers.

n73ec2b2a9d.headline: Door opens for first-home buyers to unlock ownership
n73ec2b2a9d.summary: Federal housing policy reform has advanced, with laws set to pass parliament to help first-home buyers unlock ownership. The report gave no further details on the measures.
n73ec2b2a9d.why: Housing policy affects mortgage demand, home prices and the banks and construction firms tied to the property market.

n056a387f86.summary: Thousands of Amazon workers in more than 20 countries are set to strike to demand action on labor rights and climate targets.

n9d252f10c0.headline: Revenues up 20% at Irish arm of Facebook owner to €69.7bn
n9d252f10c0.summary: Revenues at Meta's Dublin-based international headquarters rose 20%, or €11.69 billion, to €69.75 billion last year. The company describes it as a record performance.

na47a987eb2.headline: PM orders strengthened state management over e-commerce
na47a987eb2.summary: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh ordered relevant ministries and localities on November 25 to intensify state management over e-commerce.
na47a987eb2.why: Vietnam's e-commerce sector is a fast-growing retail channel, and regulatory tightening can affect online sellers and platforms operating there.

n8c14155266.headline: Trump threatens China, Mexico and Canada with new tariffs. But what does this actually mean for Americans’ pockets?
n8c14155266.summary: Donald Trump has threatened new tariffs on China, Mexico and Canada, claiming on the campaign trail that they would not cost Americans. Economists warn this is not the case.
n8c14155266.why: US tariffs on major trading partners can raise import costs, disrupt supply chains and trigger retaliation, affecting companies and markets worldwide.

naf23d009eb.headline: Exports increase by 9.57% to Rs 3 trillion in four months
naf23d009eb.summary: Exports in rupee terms rose 9.57% in the first four months of the fiscal year, totalling Rs3,029,329 million against Rs2,764,712 million a year earlier, the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics reported.
naf23d009eb.why: Export earnings are a key input to Pakistan's current account and foreign exchange reserves, which shape its economic stability.

n1b25a0d728.headline: Temasek receives CCI’s nod for investment in Rebel Foods

n4a552c6928.headline: Closing First Nations infrastructure gap could generate $635B: report
n4a552c6928.summary: A report commissioned by the Assembly of First Nations says closing the First Nations infrastructure gap could generate $635 billion in economic output over the next seven years.

n200adbbbff.headline: Mexican peso nears two-year low, trading above 20.5 per USD - Invezz
n200adbbbff.summary: The Mexican peso is nearing a two-year low, trading above 20.5 per US dollar. The report gives no specific cause for the move.
n200adbbbff.why: The peso is Mexico's currency, and its level against the dollar affects inflation, interest rate expectations and foreign investment in Mexico.

n6c836fa860.headline: 10-year Treasury yield rises after Fed minutes say to expect gradual rate cuts
n6c836fa860.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose after minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting indicated gradual rate cuts. Investors also awaited key economic data due that week.
n6c836fa860.why: The 10-year Treasury yield is the benchmark for US long-term borrowing costs and influences mortgage rates, corporate debt pricing and equity valuations.
n6c836fa860.why_moved: Fed minutes indicated that rate cuts would come gradually, and the yield rose ahead of key economic data.

nb7fa0f1d3b.headline: China’s Huawei to launch ‘milestone’ smartphone with homegrown OS
nb7fa0f1d3b.summary: Huawei will launch on November 26 its first smartphone equipped with a fully homegrown operating system, a key test of its effort to challenge Western tech dominance.
nb7fa0f1d3b.why: Huawei is a major Chinese technology company, and a domestic operating system would reduce its reliance on Western software.
